children.text: Equilibrium Expressions and Partial Pressures of Gases

Whenever gases are involved in a reaction, their partial pressures are proportional to their molar concentrations at constant temperature. Therefore, for gas-phase reactions, the reaction quotient and the equilibrium constant can be expressed in terms of the partial pressures of each gas instead of their concentrations.
